faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Sphynx?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 6-12 lb (2.7-5.5 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a kitten Sphynx?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) risk; Skin oil / yeast issues; Dental disease. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.
